teacher_info.intro:
My name is Florian, I am currently 30 years old, and I was born in Düsseldorf, Germany.
I absolutely admire learning languages, diving into foreign cultures and travelling around the world. Having started a pretty monolingual life, I now cannot live a single day without speaking another language and want to share that passion with you.

My goal is to show everybody that learning a language is like obtaining the key to a locked door that can lead you to a whole new world of experiences, history, culture, personal stories and humor. It's not comparable to anything you did in school or university.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
German obviously is my native language, and I basically have a whole life of experience speaking English at work or privately. Russian is my 3rd strongest language, and although I have no certificates confirming that, I can teach you that language up to a pretty high level, as you can see from my intro video.

Besides that, I am also very interested and knowledgeable in the field of linguistics and I can help you with pronunciation and accents on a semi-professional level by applying things like the IPA, speech training and logopedic practices.

Having said that, I do not specialize in teaching children and I very much recommend looking for a teacher that is experienced in that field.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I am a very easy-going person and I have an interactive teaching style. There is no advantage in being overly formal and distanced!

What keeps you from learning a language?
→ An old-fashioned system used by most institutions
→ Learning under pressure for exams
→ Using methods and techniques that don't fit you
→ Criticism, bad grades and exposure in front of a class
→ Not enjoying the process and not having any fun!

How can we change that?
→ Making the target language a part of you
→ Setting your goals and reaching them together
→ Finding the learning technique that fits you
→ Individually designed courses 
→ Improving through mistakes
→ Not translating, but feeling the language
teacher_info.cancel_policy:
I am very flexible as far as rescheduling is concerned and we will always find a solution, even if you would like to cancel a few hours before the lesson starts. There are only two points to pay attention to:

1.) If you have not informed me either via iTalki or Skype that you cannot attend the lesson and I do not know if you will come or not, then I am going to charge the full price of the lesson regardless of whether you call me within the hour or not.
2.) If you tell me that you are going to be late and our lesson time is limited, we can either plan a second lesson with the remaining time added afterwards or you only pay 50% of the lesson price.
